title: DualGSL: Prior-Guided Graph Structure Learning with Node-Adaptive Prediction Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.32462v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph structure learning (GSL) adapts propagation graphs to prediction tasks, but the relative predictive value of feature-derived priors and learned relations can vary across nodes. We propose DualGSL, a prior-guided framework for transductive node classification that learns node-specific weights for combining predictions from separate prior and task-adaptive propagation paths. The prior branch augments a feature graph with virtual class nodes to incorporate training-label information, while the structural branch combines learned affinity graphs with the feature-graph prior. The two branches share encoder parameters while preserving distinct representations and classification logits. A node-adaptive gate fuses the branch logits based on their projected representations, element-wise absolute difference, and prediction confidence. A joint objective integrates fused and branch-specific classification losses with prior-branch class-anchor a

translated_title: DualGSL：先验引导的图结构学习与节点自适应预测融合
translated_abstract: 图结构学习（GSL）将传播图适配到预测任务中，但基于特征的先验与学习到的关系之间的相对预测价值可能因节点而异。我们提出了DualGSL，这是一个用于直推式节点分类的先验引导框架，它学习节点特定的权重，用于组合来自独立的先验传播路径和任务自适应传播路径的预测。先验分支通过引入虚拟类别节点来增强特征图，以融入训练标签信息，而结构分支则将学习到的亲和图与特征图先验相结合。两个分支共享编码器参数，同时保持各自不同的表示和分类logits。一个节点自适应门控基于分支的投影表示、逐元素绝对差以及预测置信度来融合两个分支的logits。联合目标函数将融合后的分类损失、分支特定的分类损失以及先验分支的类别锚点损失整合在一起……
tldr: 提出了DualGSL框架，通过节点自适应门控融合先验传播路径与任务自适应传播路径的预测结果，使图结构学习能够针对不同节点动态调整两类信息的权重。
en_tdlr: DualGSL is a prior-guided graph structure learning framework that uses node-adaptive gating to fuse predictions from prior and task-adaptive propagation paths for transductive node classification.
